page.layout: Two portrait medallions side by side at the top, with their inscriptions; below them one column of text in two paragraphs; right below the text the signature mark "Ooo"; at the foot a woodcut tailpiece. Running head at the top, page number at the top right.

main_text.l: FRANC·ACCOLTIVS AR.
CEPOLA VER. BARTOLEMÆVS
FRANCISCVS Aretinus Jurisconsultus excellens mul-
ta scripsit studiosis mirum in modum utilia, super Digesta, Co-
dicem, & Decretales. Scripsit etiam Consilia, de Differentia
inter sententiam interlocutoriam & definitiuam. Magnum no-
men adeptus est per universam Italiam, præsertim in florentibus [?]
Academiis, ut Patavi, Bononiæ, & aliis. Erat valde amatus à suis
Discipulis, qui eum in quamuis Academiam migrantem, eius
studio incensi, semper sequebantur, ut in Jure magis proficeret.
Florebat anno salutis humanæ 1469. Vide Conradum Gesne-
rum, in sua Bibliotheca.
BARTHOLOMEVS Cepolla Veronensis doctissimus
Jurisconsultus fuit, numero celebriorum sui temporis ascriptus,
maximè in practica Juris, ut videre licet ex magno volumine
ab eo conscripto & hoc titulo nominato, Cautelæ causarum
Ciuilium. Scripsit etiam volumen consilorum criminalium:
Tractatum de seruitutibus: alium, De Ædilitio edicto, de Præ-
diis urbanis, De prædiis Rusticorum, De re militari, De furtis,
De Imperatore militum, De simulatis Contractibus, & plures
alios, si [?] per jus ciuile & criminale. Floruit anno salutis 1477.
Vide Conradum Gesnerum, in sua Bibliotheca.

page.notes: Two medallion portraits (left: Franciscus Accoltus, right: Bartolomeus Cepola) with their inscriptions; the inscriptions are transcribed as lines above. Woodcut tailpiece at the foot is an image, not text. Doubtful readings: "florentibus" (word partly obscured), "si" at the start of the phrase "si per jus" (the ligature is unclear). Printed hyphens kept at line ends: Co-dicem, no-men, Gesne-rum, Præ-diis. Spelling "Ædilitio", "Præ-diis" and "prædiis" follow the printed æ ligatures.
